system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:59 UTC, Zeek recorded a 23.3-second connection from WS-MLOPEZ-01 to the explicit proxy, with 51,000,324 bytes sent by the client and 9,053 bytes received. This is consistent with a large upload to the proxy, but does not identify the ultimate destination or content.

The Cisco AnyConnect VPN interface was launched minimized under maria.lopez’s account. That is inconsistent with the provided environment context of no VPN, but the record does not show that a VPN connection was established.

Before the telemetry outage, Firefox under maria.lopez’s account made a POST to metrics.eventpulse.com; the proxy returned status 301. This does not establish a relationship to the later large transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: According to the supplied sensor coverage status, WS-MLOPEZ-01 winsec and Sysmon logs and PROXY-HD-01 proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to an outage.
Zeek records the large client-to-proxy byte count, but the available record does not reveal the proxy’s upstream destination, request details, or transferred content.
claims_not_established: The external destination, service, and request associated with the 51,000,324-byte transfer.
What files or other data, if any, were transferred, and whether the transfer contained sensitive information.
Which process initiated the proxy connection and whether it was authorized activity by maria.lopez or IT.
Whether AnyConnect connected to a VPN or was involved in the transfer.
Whether the transfer was malicious or had an authorized business or patching-related explanation.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain the proxy access and egress records for the connection at approximately 13:45:36–13:46:00 UTC, including the client source port 49308, upstream destination, request method, and byte counts.
Obtain endpoint process-to-network telemetry and any recoverable Sysmon and winsec records for WS-MLOPEZ-01 during the 13:30–14:10 UTC collection gap.
Correlate firewall, DNS, and TLS records with the transfer to determine whether it reached an external destination and identify the service.
Review file access, staging, and application records around the transfer, and confirm with the user or IT whether the activity was expected.
